lines.x: Before she knew it, she had been standing here lost in thought for a long time.
Lorenz couldn't shake the feeling that she had forgotten something important, yet no matter what, she couldn't recall it.
She gazed blankly at the scenery before her. Such a boundless golden wilderness was a view she had never had the chance to stop and take in.
For the first time, she felt she truly grasped the phrase “heaven and earth” she had read in books.
Anomalous life-form research subject, research file codename Cadejo, source of all Hounds, culprit behind the Blackflow.
None of that is you anymore. You are simply you—as every life should be.
Your wounds will heal in the end, and your blood will no longer endlessly devour every life on this land.
Those places where the gold flows will eventually become beautiful fields, nourishing the lives of all things, and all things will nourish your life in turn.
Bless this land, Bolívar.
Bless you, Ca—
What happened? I didn't activate any related devices, so why did I just fall into a dream... Was that Cadejo's dream?
There's no way his wounds could already be healed. Neither he nor I should be dreaming so easily. This isn't normal...
Wait, this signal... The trapped beast in the “Prison” has been activated...
Ms. Lorenz, something's not right. Let's pull out for now.
Your presence... seems different somehow.
My plan is complete. You can actually tell that I've changed? Looks like there's one more mystery about you. Though I think I'm close to figuring out the answer.
Let's set that aside. A lot of Hounds are heading this way, and it seems something is chasing them.
I sensed it too, faintly. The Blackflow Forest really is never short on secrets and surprises.
Don't worry, those Hounds aren't coming to attack us—they've just panicked. As for the other things, they're not after us or the Hounds either.
It seems I've disturbed some beings that came here before me and changed this place. They're probably coming to check what happened here.
What do we do now?
Those things might become my next research topic. I'd like to get along with them, but for now, let's relocate.
This place is... I'd love to ask what kind of trick this instant teleportation is, but I suppose I should get used to it.
Take your time getting used to it. It's a technique I've only just mastered myself.
So what exactly happened? What made the Hounds, which had calmed down, so agitated? And what's racing toward the testing ground?
Someone found some clues, located Cadejo's tumor, and tried to remove it. That's far too reckless. I wish they'd show a little restraint.
My guess is some unlucky explorer from who-knows-where. The Melander and Coalition Government folks probably don't have the patience for something this troublesome.
It won't cause Cadejo any real pain, but it'll probably still give him and the Hounds a strange sensation.
What effect would removing the tumor have?
None at all. I imprisoned that tumor precisely because nothing works on it. Even if you kill it on the level of information and concept, it regenerates.
It's long since become part of Cadejo's body. As long as Cadejo lives, as long as Bolívar exists, it cannot be destroyed.
Still, after “Theory-4”—my “Little Theory”—was activated, and under the influence of that tumor, the very things I'd meant to study were drawn out. So it's not all bad.
The “Residents” and other strange phenomena never mentioned in past reports on the Blackflow Forest are probably all the handiwork of whoever reshaped this place before me.
How frightening. It must have been those things that pulled Cadejo and me into a dream of their making without our noticing... What on earth are they?
Ideals.
Principles.
Directives.
The future.
Utopia.
Not found yet.
Let's go create.
